# 369 Journal

> 369 Journal (App Store name: "369 Manifestation: Journal") is a calm, private iPhone and iPad journal for the 369 manifestation method: write one desire 3 times in the morning, 6 times in the afternoon and 9 times at night, every day for a 21, 33 or 45-day cycle.

Key facts:
- Free to download. The full 369 writing ritual, morning/afternoon/night reminders, progress history and a 21-day cycle are free.
- 369 Pro (optional) adds 33 and 45-day cycles, voice affirmations in your own voice, a vision board, sleep scenes, an AI ritual coach with an adaptive daily plan, breakthrough mode and grace days to recover a missed day.
- 369 Pro annual starts with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers; a one-time lifetime purchase is also available.
- Private: the journal stays on the device, no account is needed, and there is no social feed. Optional Face ID lock.
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad. Not available on Android.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/369-manifestation-journal/id6770804298
